scope: synthetic single-object transfer in MuJoCo Panda pick-and-place

rules.effect: transfer is admissible only when the task ledger explicitly grants this operation for this object and target; DENIED and UNKNOWN are not grants
transfer requires a fresh observation showing the object at the source and not already at the target
done is admissible only when the simulator terminal predicate is true
inspect is read-only and wait does not move the object; retain these alternatives when transfer is inadmissible

fail_closed.stale_state_detection: not implemented; this prototype consumes synchronous simulator observations

limits: permission and task scope are synthetic fixture fields, not real-world consent evidence
the input is already a normalized structured task; natural-language instruction interpretation is not implemented
this profile does not operationalize all PoL2 doctrines or all robotics hazards
the policy filter constrains externally observable actions and does not establish internal model reasoning
